::: {.callout-note appearance='simple' collapse=true}
## Source

Adapted from Kameron Decker Harris's Fall 2026 lecture notes "Logic 2" and "Logic 3",
which he typeset from Scott Wehrwein's Spring 2025 handwritten lecture notes.
The convention that a conditional about a variable means "for all"
comes from those notes;
the exercises are new.

The definitions are included from the
[mathematics prerequisites](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/proof-writing.html#sec-proof-definitions)
notes, so they read the same in both places.
:::
